name: SeasonRibbon
job: Show which months a product, tour or menu item is available as a twelve-month ribbon with in-season stretches in colour and the current month marked
visitor_action: hover or tap an item row to highlight its months; none required
owner_settings: Current month marker on or off
Row labels (season range text on or off)
mobile: rows stack with compact month initials
motion: ribbons unfurl across the months in a stagger, marker drops onto the current month (reduced-motion: static ribbons)
art_direction: Greengrocer: fresh-linen white, leaf green, blood-orange and plum bands, soft rounded ribbon with crisp ledger lines
